purpose: Replace further flag/shape guessing with measured primitive-level timing from the qualified c96 exact-cache path, then use the dominant primitive or shape to choose the next code candidate.
classification: diagnostic-only; profiling overhead makes every endpoint rate nonpublishable
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qualified Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M llama.cpp SYCL TP2 MTP0 path, exact F16 cache for ffn_down and ffn_gate, c96, effective total context 49152, batch 2048, ubatch 256, FUSE_EXT=31, prompt cache off, frozen same-shape oracle. Add only ONEDNN_VERBOSE=profile_exec.
analysis_plan: Archive the server log and runtime environment, parse oneDNN primitive exec records, aggregate execution time and call count by primitive implementation and problem descriptor, and report coverage/limitations. Do not compare the profiled wall rate with an unprofiled endpoint rate.
success_gate: The live runtime environment contains ONEDNN_VERBOSE=profile_exec, the log contains parseable oneDNN exec timing records, the strict harness completes with zero cached tokens and complete token IDs, and both GPUs remain healthy.
failure_policy: If verbose timing is absent, malformed, or destabilizes the run, retain the diagnostic failure and do not infer a bottleneck. No r22 throughput is eligible for promotion.
